description: This file contains the implementation of the GCD (Greatest Common Divisor) function within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including methods for evaluating GCD recursively and handling multiple arguments with validation.

classes.name: Gcd
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of a series of numbers, including validation and recursive calculation.

methods.name: evaluateGCD
methods.description: Recursively computes the GCD of two numbers using Euclid's algorithm.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the GCD of multiple numeric arguments with validation and error handling.
